facts.fact: ngCERT issued advisory ngCERT-2026-040007 on 15 September 2026 on a rise in phishing, ransomware, BEC and data breaches in Nigeria.
ngCERT is stated to operate as Nigeria's national CERT, taking incident reports by phone and email and issuing advisories.

The advisory tells organisations to report incidents in line with the National Cybersecurity Policy Strategy 2015 (as amended 2024), treated as in force; document date used as no adoption date is given.
